# pve_guest_bulk_start (Action)

Bulk starts or resumes all guests on the cluster via `POST /cluster/bulk-action/guest/start` and waits for the worker task to finish.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.

# Bulk starts or resumes the given guests cluster-wide. Invoke with:
#   apply it from a resource lifecycle block: actions = [action.pve_guest_bulk_start.start_vm100]
action "pve_guest_bulk_start" "start_vm100" {
  config {
    vms = [100]
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `max_workers` (Number) Maximum number of tasks running concurrently. Must be between 1 and 64. Defaults to 4 on the API.
- `timeout` (Number) Default start timeout in seconds. Only valid for VMs; the default depends on the guest configuration.
- `vms` (Set of Number) Only consider guests from this set of VMIDs, e.g. `[100, 101]`.
